column2: Art direction A, 'the book': a high-end interior design monograph. Thick cotton paper pages in warm off-white, very thin hairline frames, generous white margins, photo plates set like printed pages of a coffee-table book, small centred folio dots at page bottom, elegant editorial rhythm, quiet and luxurious. Three Instagram carousel slides in 4:5 portrait format side by side: slide 1 a book chapter cover page with a framed photo plate, slide 2 a double-page style spread with a photo and a block of abstract text lines, slide 3 a full-bleed photo page with a thin frame. Clean presentation board, flat lay on a warm neutral surface, soft daylight, subtle realistic shadows. Use the attached interior photographs as the pictures inside the designs, keeping the same rooms, furniture, materials and natural light. Absolutely no readable text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks: every title, caption and label is drawn as thin abstract grey lines or small blank bars. No people. Palette: warm off-white, linen, oak, brass, deep forest green #2F4A3A, discreet plum #5A2B3A, near-black ink.
